headline: China Stocks Decline to 16-Month Lows Amid US Chip Curbs and Tech Rout
summary: China's benchmark equity indexes fell to 16-month lows as tech shares tumbled. Easing margin trading requirements failed to counter concerns over global AI stocks, fresh US semiconductor curbs, and domestic growth.
why: Trade and technology restrictions between the US and China directly impact valuation multiples for Chinese technology firms.

impacts.name: Shanghai Composite
impacts.why: New semiconductor curbs and broader technology selling pushed Chinese benchmark stock indexes down.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Fresh US semiconductor restrictions and global technology sell-offs weighed on Chinese equity sentiment.
